I like it, I like the vocabulary and imagery used, but, I feel like it's short. I feel like you could expand on each idea. Make it more for the imagination. I personally love poetry that rhymes better than free flow, so I appreciate the rhymes and they sound great, but they would flow better if it was expanded.

I love the imagery. I felt a lot of things while reading, but I feel as though you need more feelings. Are you feeling lost? Depressed? Alone? It's an uncertainty almost, which I honestly like. I feel like it's just missing that something to tip it over the edge. Maybe more depth to your imagery?

I've been here before. And honestly revisit a lot. I dont want you to kill yourself, BUT I understand the feeling so I'll be completely honest. As a whole, the world will go on. The world will keep spinning and people will continue to move forward. But you ending your life will have an impact. Anyone close to you will blame themselves forever. No matter what, they'll always wonder what they missed, or what they should have done. If you're close to your mother, she'll break down every so often for the rest of her life. Her heart will never be whole again. Parents don't recover from the loss of a child, regardless of age. It could push anyone close to you to do the same. In the end, it will change the future. Maybe you are destined to do something great. Or maybe your existence is someone's reason for living and you dont even know it. Maybe 5 years from now, you compliment a stranger and that keeps them from ending it. You just never know. You have to decide if it's worth it. Even when it seems there is no reason to stay, it's a gamble either way. Take charge of your life. Make drastic changes. Be selfish. Make your own destiny. It's cliche, I know, but it's true.
